correctness.rationale: The unit-cell Gram matrix is (4I+S+S^{-1})/6; the cyclic Green row b_j=√3[(-q)^j+(-q)^(n-j)]/(1-(-q)^n), q=2-√3, solves the inverse equations for n≥3. Exact integral J(a,b) of the absolute linear nodal interpolation gives Λ_n=ΣJ, with strict-only-knot convexity via sign disagreement of adjacent kernel evaluations. The cardinal L1 norm is 2, and periodization yields strict 1<Λ_n<2. Two nearest translates dominate the defect; after centering x=m+s the tails contribute O(q^(2m)), leaving explicit piecewise-linear overlap integrals. Evaluation gives distinct positive C_even≈1.6830464193 and C_odd≈0.7011506234. Reconstructed all parameter boundaries, including n=3,4,5. Independent exact rational and float checks at n=3..5 and larger n agree and scaled deficits approach distinct coefficients. Finite checks are corroboration, not proof of asymptotic error.

evidence: Passenbrunner 2016 treats arbitrary periodic knots/orders with uniform boundedness, not refined q^floor(n/2) coefficient limits. Antonopoulos–Dougalis 2021 develops inverse circulant decay and Sobolev stability. Oct26 RESULT proves c q^m≤2-Λ_n≤4q^m, not existence/value of two normalized limits.
